govukComponents.usage: 'Continue' primary action — rendered as an anchor (<a id=continue-button class=govuk-button href=.../overview>), navigates into the task-list hub / overview page. Corroborated by the page object, which exposes ONLY this control: linkContinue = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Continue' }).
'Back' link in the page furniture above main; href="#" (JS-driven history back), id=back-link

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: back-link--next-to-breadcrumbs (custom modifier on govuk-back-link) with href="#"
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: IPAFFS-specific positioning modifier; the Back link points at '#' and relies on client-side JS to go back in history
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Custom CSS modifier outside the Design System, plus a JS-dependent back link that does nothing without JavaScript. The new app should use a real href (govuk Back link with a server-known previous URL) rather than href='#' + JS.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: govuk Back link with a genuine href to the previous page

routing.description: Interstitial with no form input. It is shown after a High or Medium risk decision; the select-risk-category handler routes High/Medium here and Low directly to the overview. The single Continue link normally advances to the Notification Hub / overview task-list. When entered with commodityDetailsPage=true it instead returns to commodity details, and with changeRiskCategory=true it returns to review.
routing.evidence: The authorised legacy select-risk-category handler routes High/Medium to this page and Low to the overview or commodity-details destination (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:99-116,123-128); a system-derived High also routes here at :47-55. This page's GET handler defaults Continue to the overview, overrides it to commodity details for commodityDetailsPage, and to review for changeRiskCategory (service/src/routes/handlers/importer/health_certificate_required.js:13-31). The template contains no form or data-entry control, only the Continue anchor (service/src/views/importer/healthCertificateRequired.html:11-20). Corroborating QA evidence: workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:314-326,697-707,881-887; types/risk-category.ts:1-5.

testAssertions.assertion: Accessibility: the 'Health Certificate Required Page' must render with zero accessibility violations (axe check via checkPageAccessibility).
The only interactive control the tests drive on this page is the 'Continue' link, which advances to the Notification Hub. No fields, no validation, no secondary actions are exercised.

openQuestions: RESOLVED FROM LEGACY: the interstitial is shown after High or Medium risk and skipped for Low; the normal Continue target is the overview. The legacy handlers also reveal two return-flow variants: commodityDetailsPage=true continues to commodity details, while changeRiskCategory=true continues to review (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:99-128 and service/src/routes/handlers/importer/health_certificate_required.js:13-31). RESIDUAL POLICY QUESTION: risk can be user-selected or system-derived in the legacy handler (:47-65,99-112); confirm the rebuild's intended ownership of categorisation.

The Back link (href='#', JS-driven) sits in the page furniture above main; its true target/behaviour is not observable from the frozen snapshot and is not driven by any test (no page-object locator for it).

No validation messages exist for this page and none could exist — it is a read-only interstitial with a single navigation link and no form input. Confirmed by the legacy template (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/healthCertificateRequired.html:11-20) and the page object exposing only linkContinue (page-objects/notification/HealthCertificateRequiredPage.ts:6-8). Recorded here so a human does not treat the empty validationMessages array as an unmined gap.

Legacy-vs-rendered URL discrepancy: the rendered spec records /notification/vnet/protected/notifications/{notificationId}/health-certificate-required, while the legacy route is /protected/notifications/{referenceNumber}/health-certificate-required (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/routes.js:1234-1238). The rendered, confirmed URL is retained; establish whether /notification/vnet is an external context path rather than part of the application route.
